steps: Heat the oil in a pan and soften the onion, ginger and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes with a splash of water, cover, and cook until they turn mushy.
Let it cool a little, then blend it into a smooth sauce.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the bay leaf and chilli powder for a few seconds.
Pour in the sauce with the salt and sugar, and simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until it thickens a little.
Add the paneer cubes and cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the crushed kasuri methi, garam masala and cream, then turn off the heat.
Scatter coriander leaves on top and serve hot.
note: Two of the three sources cook onion with the tomatoes, so onion is now included; the third uses tomato alone. The single green chilli from one source is left out.
